name: patent-time-split-toxicity-benchmark
description: A benchmark that measures models' ability to detect toxic content in patent text while evaluating temporal generalization via a time-based train/test split. It focuses on robustness to distributional shifts over time in technical patent language. The dataset enables evaluation of both binary toxicity classification and continuous toxicity scoring on patent corpora.
reputation: A niche but useful dataset for robustness and safety research focused on technical patent language; adoption is modest within toxicity and robustness communities.
